answer: The gate is a state teaching certificate: a degree, a year of supervised practice and an exam. It is a bridge from training to classroom; the register ties one certificate to one teacher, one school and one identity, rejecting duplicates. Each fake needs one teacher, 1,800 units and 365 days in a real school, an oasis no bought paper can fake. One vertex per certificate means 100 fakes cost 180,000 units and 100 teacher-years. Cheapest cheat: hire a teacher to lend a certificate for 3,000 units; the lender surrenders their backing and faces deregistration, and a forgery fails the live lookup.
